title: Unsafe dict access can raise KeyError
evidence: order["customer"] raises a KeyError when the 'customer' key is missing; the safe .get() was removed.
recommendation: restore order.get('customer'), or guard the key before subscripting.

title: Off-by-one: items[i + 1] reads past the end
evidence: looping for i in range(len(items)) while indexing items[i + 1] reads one past the end on the last iteration -> IndexError.
